title: Bulk discount feature
prompt: Add a bulk discount feature. In shop/pricing.py add bulk_discount(items, min_qty=10, percent=5): if the total quantity across all (price, qty) items is at least min_qty, return the items' total reduced by percent percent, otherwise return the undiscounted total. Extend shop.orders.place_order with a keyword argument bulk=False; when True the order's subtotal must be the bulk-discounted total. Add tests for the new behaviour and mention the feature in README.md.
